body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Matsunichi, a Hongkong-based digital entertainment and mobile storage products manufacturing company, introduced its new digital picture frame with extended iPod video docking systems during 2007 CES Unveiled.

Besides the primary feature of digital picture frame capable of showing video files, the most innovative feature is iPod docking with extended display which allows users to navigate iPod video/audio files easily on a large display.

‘iPF 70’ is another portable docking video system with 4-hour battery play time, which was designed for users who want to share multimedia content stored on their iPod with others with its 7-inch color LCD display. It features built-in 2-way speakers and subwoofer, and headphone jack. It can recharge iPod’s internal battery when docked.
